title: Paxos asset cards
description: A centred title and grey lead over a row of four tall near-white cards with thin hairlines and 8px corners: each opens with a coloured icon disc and a bold ticker, then a 24px name, a short slate description and a 'learn more ›' link pinned to the bottom. A full-width banner card below pairs one sentence with an outline pill. Cards stack on phones; links fade on hover.
notes: each card's disc colour is a token name (chart-1…chart-5, primary, glow, highlight)
